label: Importer of record (trading partner)
what_partner_brings: Import registration, customs clearance, regulatory filing as applicant of record, bonded storage
commercial_framework: Per-shipment fee or % of CIF; or brief title + fixed markup; 12-month term
what_we_ask_first: Registration proof, filing track record, storage near port

label: Distributor
what_partner_brings: Warehousing, last mile, sales force, outlet relationships
commercial_framework: Gross margin + target incentive; credit days; territory/channel exclusivity only against a minimum purchase commitment
what_we_ask_first: Coverage, sales force, competing lines, references

label: Full-service distributor
what_partner_brings: Import + registration + national distribution incl. institutional
commercial_framework: Blended discount off list with volume tiers; 2–3 year term
what_we_ask_first: Channel reach, registration track record, onboarding terms

label: Co-packer
what_partner_brings: Filling/bottling line, QC, local production registration
commercial_framework: Per-unit fill fee; royalty if licensed manufacture; pilot 3–6 months

label: B2B platform
what_we_ask_first: Category fit, commission, purchase vs consignment

label: Retail chain
what_we_ask_first: Listing fee, payment days, returns, delivery model

label: Own full-cycle entry
what_we_bring: Own entity imports, stores, sells, collects
